name: v0.2.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add badge to README.md by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/13
* update modules 20240420 by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/14
* update modules 20241221 by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/15
* Add support for fallback analyze by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/16
* Output complete by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/17
* Update modules 20250527 by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/18
* update modules 20250831 by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/19
* update modules to latest versions by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/20
* Bump filippo.io/edwards25519 from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/21
* Update go version and dependencies by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/22
* Update dependencies and modernize code by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/23
* Update GoReleaser and GitHub Actions versions by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/24
* Add binary and package installation instructions to README.md by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/25
* Do not use TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN for uploading Homebrew tap formulae by @noborus in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/26

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/pull/21

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/noborus/mdtsql/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
